name: Video Download
dependency: FFmpeg/ffprobe installed, private application running, source successfully imported.
notes: Authenticated generated-clip downloads only. Source video is previewed inline but has no explicit full-source download action; preview bytes are not DRM-protected.

name: Bulk Video Clip Export
dependency: FFmpeg/ffprobe installed, private application running, source successfully imported.
notes: Bulk ZIP download contains generated MP4 clips only and removes the temporary archive after the response.

name: Full HD Video Rendering (1080p)
dependency: FFmpeg/ffprobe installed, private application running, source successfully imported.
notes: 1080p export is available through the real FFmpeg renderer; 16:9 output verified at 1920x1080.

name: Ultra HD Video Export (4K)
dependency: Local implementation, FFmpeg/media tooling where applicable, and feature-specific integration tests.
notes: 4K remains in the original roadmap, but the user explicitly accepts 720p–1080p initially. Do not claim that upscaling restores missing detail.
